display_long_description:
🎯 Gaze - Perfect for those with limited mobility

Head-movement only interaction
- No hand movement required
- Engaging visual experiences controlled entirely through natural head movements
- Accessibility focused
- Ideal for patients with restricted arm or hand mobility
- Immersive mini-games designed for head-based navigation.

🖐 Hands - Designed for gentle interaction with subtle hand movements

Subtle hand movement activities - Carefully calibrated for patients with limited dexterity

Gentle mini-games that encourage beneficial, comfortable movement
Adaptive experiences that respond to patient capabilities
Rehabilitation support through engaging interactive content

🧘 Relax - no hand or head movements
- Complete comfort experiences
- Limited physical movement
- Perfect for patients with severe mobility limitations
- Pure immersive relaxation environments
- Calming peaceful settings

Useful for Stress and anxiety reduction experiences for pre/post-operative care. Helps
with patient Mindfulness-based content for deep relaxation.

🔐 Privacy & Security Guarantee - Your patients' privacy is our priority

HoVR operates entirely online with no patient data recorded.

HoVR is built by Mobiddiction  Pty Ltd Australia, creators of PatientVR.
